mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, c.name AS customerName, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status FROM crm_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.organization_id = #{orgId} AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
